source.notes: One case per script; in.spells lists the test spells (casters are Creatures 0x80000010..12, the item 0x80000020 is a GenericObject; the target is Creature 0x80000001). in.ops: {cast, caster, equip} or {heartbeat: seconds}. out: per op, the result (stack, layer: AddEnchantmentResult.StackType and Enchantment.LayerId; absent for a heartbeat), the registry in list order, and add/mul = the cached Strength modifiers read after the op.
